## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (success, validation and permission cases where they apply)
- [ ] Backend: `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `pytest` pass
- [ ] Frontend: `lint`, `typecheck`, `test` pass
- [ ] API changes are declared in the backend and `backend/schema.yml` / `frontend/src/api/schema.ts` are regenerated
- [ ] Database changes include a migration
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or setup changed
- [ ] No real student data, secrets or credentials anywhere in this change
